basis: Selected publisher-reported sale observations, not the complete market or independent authenticated transactions

normalisation.included: Same named project, residential serviced-apartment records and stated compact/near-size cohorts; dates retained. Observed bands are descriptions of these records only.
normalisation.excluded: Shops, Eve 1066/1087 sqft, Maxim 883/1033 sqft and 624/678 sqft, reserves and asking prices. Older Eve 2023 anomaly not silently blended into the recent cohort.
normalisation.reason: No supported numeric bay, condition, lease-rights, package or time adjustment was found. No price-per-square-foot scaling or invented uncertainty haircut.

R306.claim: Useful compact-cohort price context; 370000 ask is within this observed envelope. Neither a discount nor a target-unit valuation is established.
R306.missing_link: 680 marketed sqft versus 689 transaction sqft membership, and whether material bay/condition/package differences explain price dispersion. Six-month data lag cannot be extrapolated away.

KV01.claim: Historical near-size context only; not a current 825 sqft fair-value band.
KV01.missing_link: Current comparable price for the 825/829 product and supported treatment of 850 sqft/condition/rights differences; the March 2026 829 sqft price is not visible.
